items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...He had a wonderful memory for Tate, so we could check. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, my God, he could beat me.

ctx.x: Well, he played in the Tulaneans until he was 80 years, until he was 70 years old.
Oh, who took your place with Hurt? Bob Coquille. Well, Bob, I interviewed Bob a couple of times. He had a wonderful memory for Tate, so we could check.
Well, my God, he could beat me. Well, Bob's dead now, isn't he?
